note: Seeded departures from the United Nations Editorial Manual the un brief names: US spellings (program, center, labor), numbers and number formats, US-style dates and times, decades and centuries, country names, an abbreviation used before its full name, lower-case "member states" and "secretary-general", gender-exclusive language, and informal or non-neutral tone. The rest of each document follows UN style ("per cent", "21 April 2004", "12.30 p.m.", "Member States"), so it gives a precise reviewer things not to flag.

coastal-resilience-report.md.issue: The abbreviation "CRF" is used before the full name "Coastal Resilience Fund (CRF)", which only appears in the next sentence; give the full name at first use.
Date in US format; UN style is "14 March 2025".
A number under 10 in figures; spell it out ("five delegations").
Decade written as "the 90's"; UN style is "the 1990s".

coastal-resilience-report.md.quote: The new early-warning system has been a real game-changer for island communities.
coastal-resilience-report.md.issue: Informal, promotional wording ("a real game-changer"); state the effect in formal, neutral terms.
Gender-exclusive language; use "Each fishing household" or "fishers and their families".

coastal-resilience-report.md.quote: Frankly, the results so far have been pretty disappointing.
coastal-resilience-report.md.issue: The whole paragraph is informal and accusatory ("talk a big game", "put their money where their mouth is"); rewrite it in a formal, neutral tone.

meeting-information-note.md.quote: The third session of the IWG
meeting-information-note.md.issue: The abbreviation "IWG" is used before the full name, which only appears in the next sentence; give the full name at first use.

meeting-information-note.md.quote: 15 Member States have confirmed their participation.
meeting-information-note.md.issue: A sentence starts with a figure; spell it out ("Fifteen Member States").
Time in US format; UN style is "1.30 p.m.".

meeting-information-note.md.quote: Please don't be late — nobody likes sitting around waiting for stragglers.
meeting-information-note.md.issue: Informal tone and a contraction; ask for punctual attendance in formal, neutral terms.

meeting-information-note.md.quote: Each head of delegation should ensure that his credentials
meeting-information-note.md.issue: The paragraph assumes every delegate is a man ("his", "he", "their wives"); rewrite it in gender-inclusive language ("their credentials", "spouses").
Not the official UN country name; use "the Republic of Korea".

session-summary.md.issue: Century in figures; UN style is "the twentieth century".
The abbreviation "WSDP" is used before the full name, which only appears in the next sentence; give the full name at first use.
"percent" is inconsistent with "per cent" in the same sentence; UN style uses "per cent" consistently.
Not the official UN country name; use "Türkiye".
A decimal without a leading zero; write "0.85".

session-summary.md.quote: every farmer must be able to feed his family and his workers
session-summary.md.issue: Gender-exclusive language; recast in the plural ("all farmers must be able to feed their families and workers").

session-summary.md.quote: In what can only be called a stunning triumph
session-summary.md.issue: The paragraph is promotional and hyperbolic ("smashed every expectation", "truly historic", "forever"); rewrite it as a neutral account of what the Committee decided.
